judgement.reason: openstatus is a stack of cooperating services (dashboard, API server, workflows, checkers, status page) plus libSQL and Tinybird/ClickHouse, which Deployz cannot run as one web process.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yaml defines 7 application services (libsql, tinybird-local, workflows, server, private-location, dashboard, status-page). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose stack runs a libsql server, tinybird-local and several internal application services, and none of the shown lines prove that the dashboard runs without them or that they map to a datastore Deployz provides.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: apps/ holds the Dockerfiles of 9 component images (checker, dashboard, private-location, railway-proxy, screenshot-service, server), so the app is a stack of cooperating services. Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The apps directory holds several component images, such as checker, server and private-location, that cooperate with the dashboard, and nothing shown proves they are optional for production.
